steps.name: verify two donations before duplicate grant
do: assert(quest:GetStateBool('DoneIntro')); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksInGame')==40); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==2); assert(quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook')); assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,0),quest:GetHero()), 'donated book still in inventory'); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==(i<2),name..'['..i..']') end end; assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,1),quest:GetHero()),'second donated book still in inventory'); Runner.twoDonationsLoaded=true

steps.name: grant previously donated book zero
do: local key=quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,0); if not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()) then quest:GiveHeroObject(key,1) end; assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()))

steps.name: teacher rejects duplicate donation
do: Runner.duplicateSceneSeen=false; Runner.probe=function(q) if q:IsInMovieSequence() then Runner.duplicateSceneSeen=true end end
steps.until: Runner.duplicateSceneSeen and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()

steps.name: verify duplicate retained and all donation state unchanged
do: assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==2 and quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()); assert(quest:GetStateInt('LastBookRequested')==-1); assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,0),quest:GetHero())); assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,1),quest:GetHero())); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==(i<2),name..'['..i..']') end end; assert(Runner.duplicateSceneSeen); Runner.probe=nil; Runner.duplicateVerified=true
